title: Bitium Authentication
description: Enables SSO user authentication with Bitium

settings_def.name: issuer_id
settings_def.label: Entity ID (URL)
settings_def.description: You can find this value under the SSO tab within the Deskpro app on your Bitium account

settings_def.name: sso_url
settings_def.label: Login URL
settings_def.description: You can find this value under the SSO tab within the Deskpro app on your Bitium account

settings_def.name: slo_url
settings_def.label: Logout URL
settings_def.description: You can find this value under the SSO tab within the Deskpro app on your Bitium account

settings_def.name: cert
settings_def.label: x509 Certificate
settings_def.description: You can find this value under the SSO tab within the Deskpro app on your Bitium account.

settings_def.name: login_custom_text
settings_def.label: Login Button Text
settings_def.description: The text that appears on the button on the login page. Not shown if using the Automatic SSO Method setting. This is also optional - leave blank to show no button.

settings_def.name: sso_type
settings_def.label: SSO Method
settings_def.description: When SSO is enabled, users will be automatically logged-in when they visit Deskpro.

settings_def.name: auto_agent
settings_def.label: Auto Agent
settings_def.checkbox_label: Automatically create agents if they do not already exist

settings_def.name: raw_info_filter
settings_def.label: Filter
settings_def.description: You can filter based on info provided by the usersource. Learn about this feature
